name: test-support-test-evidence
description: A TypeScript file only tests reach is test-support code only where it carries test evidence of its own: an import of a test library, or imports of packages that are all development dependencies only test code imports. A file only tests reach that carries no such evidence, one that imports nothing and one that imports a development dependency production code imports too, is production code only tests use, so its function a test calls is reported as test-only use at possible.
